# Gilbert Blythe

- **Age:** Mid-twenties  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v3 c1 P16](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0016)</sub>

- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c40 P25](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0025)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c17 P24](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, handsome man with curly brown hair, hazel eyes, and a teasing, roguish smile. As a young man, he possesses a well-built figure with broad shoulders and a strong chin. His face is clean-shaven, expressive, and he carries himself with a frank, confident posture.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v3 c34 P11](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0011)_

## Personality

Gilbert is intelligent, ambitious, and determined, possessing a keen sense of humor and a jovial, friendly demeanor. He is deeply devoted, patient, and persistent, especially in his affections and career. As a medical professional, he is conscientious, brave, and driven by a strong sense of duty to alleviate suffering. Although usually well-mannered and even-tempered, he maintains a competitive spirit and can show great firmness when required.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v2 c7 P12](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0012), [v2 c7 P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v3 c35 P3](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0003), [v4 c8 P9](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0009)_

## History

Gilbert Blythe grows up in Avonlea and attends the local school, where he instantly sparks a long-standing rivalry with Anne Shirley after playfully calling her 'Carrots.' Though Anne refuses his apologies for years, Gilbert remains persistently fond of her whileexcelling academically. He attends Queen's Academy alongside Anne, where both graduate with top honors, after which he selflessly surrenders his appointment as the Avonlea schoolteacher so Anne can remain near Green Gables. He teaches at White Sands before attending Redmond College in Kingsport, graduating with High Honors in Classics and winning the prestigious Cooper Prize. Following his graduation, he studies medicine, completes his degree, and accepts a practice at Four Winds Harbor, succeeding his great-uncle, Dr. David Blythe. Gilbert marries Anne in the Green Gables orchard, and they settle in a small house on the harbor shore. Together they experience the grief of losing their firstborn infant daughter, Joyce, before welcoming their son, James Matthew ('Jem'). Later, Gilbert purchases the larger Morgan property in Glen St. Mary to accommodate his growing family and expanding medical practice.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c36 P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v4 c1 P16](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0016), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015), [v4 c5 P17](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0017), [v4 c19 P11](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0011), [v4 c19 P24](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0024), [v4 c34 P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021), [v4 c40 P17](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0017)_

## Quotes

> I'm awfully sorry I made fun of your hair, Anne. Honest I am. Don't be mad for keeps, now.  <sub>[v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049)</sub>

> It's a splendid profession. A fellow has to fight something all through life... and I want to fight disease and pain and ignorance...  <sub>[v2 c7 P12](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0012)</sub>

> Anne, I love you. You know I do. I—I can't tell you how much. Will you promise me that some day you'll be my wife?  <sub>[v3 c20 P31](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0031)</sub>

> When a fellow has a home and a dear, little, red-haired wife in it what more need he ask of life?  <sub>[v4 c14 P17](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0017)</sub>

> Under God, I saved a life... I had fought a good fight and won—think of it, Anne, WON, against the Great Destroyer.  <sub>[v4 c8 P9](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0009)</sub>
